== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English [[Limited Resources]] and [[Limited Resources (Errata)]] articles. Do not transclude onto Japanese, Unlimited, Two-Player, foil, or (V) articles. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. Columns are Original · Decipher Errata. {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
